title: Home guide: checking the soil jars safely
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Everyday materials and how they change (Muck, Mess & Mixtures and Will It Degrade?)
source: Written for science/y2 lesson 9 (Home practical guide: checking the soil jars safely (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Look at the jars and see which materials have rotted.
safety: Do not open the jars or sniff them
Wash your hands after touching them
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Look through the side of each jar.
Under each drawing write one word: rotting, soggy, same or no change.
